title: Exact-capacity sessions split too early
description: Whole-chapter sessions unexpectedly split when their combined page count equals the configured limit. Repair chapter_sessions(chapter_lengths, limit) without changing input order or the handling of oversized chapters.

requirements.text: chapter_sessions(chapter_lengths, limit) returns lists of whole chapter lengths in original order, greedily filling each session while its sum stays <= limit. Flush a nonempty session before a chapter that would make its sum exceed limit. An individually oversized chapter must occupy its own session unchanged. Never emit empty sessions; empty input returns [].
The chapter_lengths list must remain unchanged on successful returns and ValueError paths, including when multiple chapters fit exactly into a session or a chapter is oversized.

chapter_lengths must be a list of plain integers from 1 through 1000000 inclusive, and limit must be a plain integer in the same range. Reject booleans, floats, strings (including Unicode), null, out-of-range integers and a non-list chapter_lengths value with ValueError.
